nodes.label: Rule: Playwright CLI, not MCP
nodes.rationale: CLI identical in every harness (MCP wired per client) and cheaper in context (no large tool schemas/accessibility trees); MCP better for long-running autonomous loops

nodes.label: E2E locator and assertion guidelines

nodes.label: Never delete, move rule

nodes.label: gh --attach Flag (gh 2.99+)
nodes.rationale: Attach visual evidence only when it saves reviewer a checkout (UI fix, before/after, new flow, failure state); skip for refactors/backend-only. Limits: 10MB images, 10/100MB videos, push access, GitHub.com/GHEC only.

nodes.label: run-code Command
nodes.rationale: Escape hatch for scenarios not covered by CLI commands; code must be a single function expression wrapped in (...) and evaluated, no import/export/require.

nodes.label: Named Browser Sessions (-s flag)
nodes.rationale: Each session isolates cookies, storage, IndexedDB, cache, history, tabs; enables concurrent scraping and A/B comparisons. Headless sessions idle-timeout after an hour.

nodes.label: Storage State File (state-save / state-load)
nodes.rationale: Security: never commit state files with auth tokens, gitignore *.auth-state.json, delete after automation; in-memory sessions safer by default.

nodes.label: Manual Assertions (toBeVisible, toHaveText, toMatchAriaSnapshot)
nodes.rationale: Generated code captures actions not assertions; avoid text-based locators when asserting text.

nodes.label: Seed Test (tests/seed.spec.ts)
nodes.rationale: Minimal test landing page in starting state; preferred pattern pushes navigation into tests/fixtures.ts so scenarios reuse it.

nodes.label: Spec Plan File (specs/<feature>.plan.md)
nodes.rationale: Independent kebab-case scenarios starting from seed state; user-level steps; expect bullets become assertions; one test per file.

nodes.label: Trace Output Files (.trace, .network, resources)
nodes.rationale: Start tracing before the problem to capture whole flow; clean old traces due to disk usage. Best for debugging vs video for demos.

nodes.label: Mobile Device Emulation (--mobile)
nodes.rationale: Mobile pages usually lighter, so snapshots smaller and cheaper.

nodes.label: WebMCP Page Tools
nodes.rationale: Prefer page-registered tools over UI driving: one call replaces click/fill sequences. Tool metadata comes from page so treat as untrusted input; check [consequential] annotation.

nodes.label: Backup Vault (~/.workshop-backup)
nodes.rationale: Never delete, move; never clobber unrestored vault since second clean would bury first backup.

nodes.label: enabledPlugins in settings.json
nodes.rationale: Moving plugin folder insufficient; harness may re-download plugins still listed in enabledPlugins.

nodes.rationale: Workshop demo project deliberately has no agent docs as measured baseline; never invent any, only move existing after user confirms.

nodes.label: Restore Command
nodes.rationale: Walk moves in reverse; never overwrite new config, park as <name>.from-backup for manual merge.

nodes.label: Plan-Generate-Heal Workflow
nodes.rationale: All phases rely on --debug=cli + attach to drive paused page via seed test so custom setup is captured; never open app URL directly. Heal one failure at a time; never add sleeps or networkidle; ask user when unclear if regression or stale spec.

nodes.label: Semantic (Role-based) Locators
nodes.rationale: Role-based locators more resilient than fragile CSS selectors.

nodes.label: Hero Script Recording
nodes.rationale: For proof-of-work videos write a script executed via run-code to control pauses, typing delay, and annotations; best proof of work for user-facing PR.

nodes.label: Reuse Running Dev App Policy
nodes.rationale: User may already run npm run dev on ports 5173/3001 sharing one SQLite DB; check /health, reuse if up, never kill processes or run seed/reset without asking, avoid destructive actions on seeded accounts so user's data/session is not broken.

nodes.label: Auth Preservation Rule
nodes.rationale: Never touch .credentials.json, .claude.json, argv.json; user must stay logged in or workshop stops.

nodes.label: Clean Context Baseline
nodes.rationale: Workshop measures token baseline; customizations (plugins, skills, agents) inflate context by thousands of tokens before user types, so remove then restore after.

nodes.label: Admin lifecycle API (shipments, transitions, tracking)
nodes.rationale: Intentionally no operations UI
